Bounding box:  xmin: -79.328 ymin: 43.79446 xmax: -78.43695 ymax: 44.51701

![](/assets/osm.jpg)

Rename `map` to `map.osm`.

Make sure your current working directory is `sumo_workshop`.

```powershell
netconvert --osm data/osm/map.osm -o module1/03-osm/map.net.xml `
     --ramps.guess `
     --junctions.join `
     --junctions.join-dist 15 `
     --tls.guess-signals `
     --tls.discard-simple `
     --tls.join `
     --tls.default-type static `
     -t "$env:SUMO_HOME/data/typemap/osmNetconvert.typ.xml" `
     --output.street-names `
     --output.original-names `
     --keep-edges.by-vclass passenger `
     --remove-edges.isolated `
     --geometry.remove `
     --geometry.max-segment-length 50 `
     --edges.join `
     --junctions.corner-detail 5 `
     --no-internal-links
```


```powershell
netconvert --osm data/osm/map.osm -o module1/03-osm/map_highway.net.xml `
     --ramps.guess `
     --junctions.join `
     --junctions.join-dist 15 `
     --tls.guess-signals `
     --tls.discard-simple `
     --tls.join `
     --tls.default-type static `
     -t "$env:SUMO_HOME/data/typemap/osmNetconvert.typ.xml" `
     --output.street-names `
     --output.original-names `
     --keep-edges.by-vclass passenger `
     --remove-edges.isolated `
     --geometry.remove `
     --geometry.max-segment-length 50 `
     --edges.join `
     --junctions.corner-detail 5 `
     --no-internal-links `
     --keep-edges.by-type highway.motorway,highway.trunk,highway.primary,highway.secondary,highway.tertiary
```
